acceptance: Velox accepts documented Spark and gluten keys, rejects adapter-owned keys, and records applied settings in the ledger.
LakeSail either applies only a verified honoured-key set or warns and records dropped; behaviour is documented.
No alias from velox/lakesail to spark in the capability registry or template discovery.
Live evidence (or an explicit unverified note) for each engine is attached to the PR.
context: Origin: user-approved 2026-09-30; Opus Considerations on LakeSail and review finding R8. Low urgency; native Spark first.
description:
SparkAdapter, VeloxAdapter and LakeSailAdapter share SparkLikeAdapterMixin but not configuration semantics, so each needs its own decision after native Spark ships.
- Velox/Gluten: accepts standard Spark SQL keys plus spark.gluten.* ; adapter-owned keys (spark.plugins, spark.shuffle.manager, spark.memory.offHeap.* in velox.py ~L395-398) stay rejected. Remote Velox over Spark Connect rejects core keys server-side. Needs live verification with a Gluten build.
- LakeSail: a Rust engine behind Spark Connect. A successful conf.set records "executed" even for keys Sail ignores. Build a verified list of honoured keys (or an advisory tag on ledger statements) before shipping Sail templates or accepting the map; until then, a spark map on LakeSail warns and is recorded as dropped.
- Template discovery is keyed by platform directory: Velox and LakeSail stay `tuned-fallback` until they have their own templates; do NOT alias them to spark.
- Use the preflight capture from spark-effective-config-preflight-capture to confirm what each engine actually reports.
